fusions.name: Lance the Swelling
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 16 poison damage, draws out every affliction you have on the target and deals 60% more damage for each one drawn, then leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Carried Bitterness
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 3 tiles long that deals 3 poison damage to everything in it and leaves each [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Pare Away the Rot
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 poison conditions from you and your allies and restores 12 health.

fusions.name: Drawn Into the Blade
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 8% poison resistance.
